from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,html
base=Path('products/services/software-renewals')
w=base/'supplier-access/delivery/worksheet-en-fr.md'
specs=[('framework-access/raw/g-cloud-14.html',['expired on 28 October 2026','will remain in effect for their full defined terms']),('gcloud15-access/raw/agreement.html',['Issue the invitation to tender','All key subcontractors','6 August 2026','5 February 2028'])]
records=[]
for rel,terms in specs:
 p=base/rel
 raw=p.read_bytes()
 text=html.unescape(re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',raw.decode('utf-8')))
 text=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',text)
 passages=[]
 for term in terms:
  pos=text.lower().find(term.lower())
  passages.append({'term':term,'found':pos>=0,'passage':text[max(0,pos-220):pos+len(term)+400] if pos>=0 else None})
 records.append({'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'passages':passages})
result={'status':'INDEPENDENT_SOURCE_CHECK_NOT_PUBLICATION_APPROVAL','worksheet_sha256':hashlib.sha256(w.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'worksheet':w.read_text(),'original_source_checks':records,'remaining_review':['Verify reopening and equal-assessment claims against original saved ODT','Check HSE route discrepancy against its exact original release','Assess complete bilingual qualifications and observation provenance'],'publication_scope':'Standalone worksheet only; no clean site candidate or exact deployment digest established'}
out=Path('products/reviews/supplier-worksheet/source-check.json')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print(out.read_text())
